text:
rae_sales: Quick alert — Halcyon Retail escalated to their CEO. CISO says they will only sign if we support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS) and a firm throughput SLA for flash-sales. Procurement also asked for a capex purchase path. Can infra/legal/pricing pick this up? cc @tyler_se @harpreet_infra @olga_legal @cory_pricing

tyler_se: I can own the tech coord. Need a short traffic profile: burst length, baseline, and p95 target. Any attach?

rae_sales: Uploaded a snapshot from their telemetry to the invite. Peak bursts ~14k req/min for ~8-12 minutes, baseline ~2.5-3.5k. p95 target ~120-150ms.

harpreet_infra: From infra POV: our warmed-dedicated config reaches ~11k steady with warmed KV cache. To hit 14k during bursts we have two practical options: (1) small reserved burst pool sized +3.5k qps (best SLA fit), or (2) aggressive autoscale with warm standby nodes + pre-warmed cache lanes (cheaper avg). If they insist on HSM, we need VPC private deploy or dedicated VPC peering — that adds ~3-4w for approvals and certs.

olga_legal: CISO also requested explicit key custody language, access controls, and audit log access. I'll draft a DPA addendum for BYO-KMS with rotation attestations and compromise notification timeline. Which KMS vendors are they planning?

cory_pricing: Capex path OK — we can structure a 12/24 month reserved-pool purchase. I need delta $/month between reserved pool vs autoscale to model amortized capex and one-time procurement billing.

nina_prod: I'll prepare a short customer-facing SLA options doc that lists fallback policies (model variant fallback, regional failover, degraded latency windows) and recommended acceptance criteria. Useful to set expectations if traffic overshoots.

tyler_se: I'll post a one-page ops note by 11:30am PST: assumptions, option A (reserved burst) vs B (autoscale), estimated latencies with warmed cache, and rough cost delta. Also call out HSM timeline and steps.

olga_legal: Drafting DPA addendum. Will include required attestations: key ownership proof, rotation cadence, export controls, audit log retention period, and emergency key escrow procedure. Posting draft by 3pm for review.

ops_bot: Ticket INC-52341 created — "Halcyon Retail exec escalation: BYO-KMS + throughput SLA + capex request". Assigned to infra-team oncall.

rae_sales: Action items recap: (1) tyler_se/hardpreet - ops note + numbers by 11:30am PST, (2) cory_pricing - capex model after cost delta is posted, (3) olga_legal - DPA addendum draft by 3pm, (4) nina_prod - SLA options doc, (5) I'll schedule a 30-min exec bridge with Halcyon sec & procurement for 4pm PT. Please post any artifacts here. :thumbsup:

tyler_se: Quick Q — do they require hardware HSM in-country or will cloud-HSM suffice? Halcyon mentioned regulatory constraints. If it's in-country HSM, timeline may be longer.

rae_sales: They're leaning toward in-country HSM for EU traffic. I'm confirming.

harpreet_infra: Noted. If EU in-country HSM is required and we need Private deployment, highlight that Dedicated + peering will likely incur both monthly infra delta and one-time integration fees. I'll include rough numbers in the ops note.

cory_pricing: Also flag that capex quoting will need procurement PO terms — include sample payment schedule.

rae_sales: Thanks — will update after 4pm bridge. Keep thread for updates.
